About

I’m a data science undergraduate at NUST SEECS focused on analysis, machine learning, and building projects that make abstract ideas concrete.

My background includes programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data structures and algorithms, databases, Python, SQL, and applied work with pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, and machine learning workflows.

This site is intentionally closer to a personal publication than a static CV. I use it to share project notes, technical write-ups, and the ideas that shape how I work.

If you want the quick version of what I do: I like turning data into stories, code into useful systems, and ideas into projects that people can inspect.

For contact, use GitHub, LinkedIn, or email.
